description: Defines a utility enum with a static method to open the first valid URL from a list of candidates using macOS system APIs.

classes.name: SystemSettingsURLSupport
classes.description: A utility enum providing static methods to handle URLs related to system settings. Currently includes a method to open the first valid URL from a list.

methods.name: openFirst
methods.description: Iterates over given URL strings and opens the first valid one using the system's workspace.
